mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE assembly_path AS ( SELECT child_device_sn FROM ast_device_assembly WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND parent_device_sn = #{query.ancestorDeviceSn} AND effective_to IS NULL AND deleted = b'0' UNION DISTINCT SELECT relation.child_device_sn FROM ast_device_assembly relation JOIN assembly_path path ON path.child_device_sn = relation.parent_device_sn WHERE relation.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND relation.effective_to IS NULL AND relation.deleted = b'0' ) SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM assembly_path WHERE child_device_sn = #{query.descendantDeviceSn} )

WITH RECURSIVE assembly_tree AS ( SELECT id, parent_device_sn, child_device_sn, position_code, assembly_type, effective_from, effective_to, evidence_ref, source_system, source_key, source_version, version, tenant_id, 1 AS tree_depth FROM ast_device_assembly WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND parent_device_sn = #{query.rootDeviceSn} AND effective_to IS NULL AND deleted = b'0' UNION ALL SELECT relation.id, relation.parent_device_sn, relation.child_device_sn, relation.position_code, relation.assembly_type, relation.effective_from, relation.effective_to, relation.evidence_ref, relation.source_system, relation.source_key, relation.source_version, relation.version, relation.tenant_id, tree.tree_depth + 1 FROM ast_device_assembly relation JOIN assembly_tree tree ON tree.child_device_sn = relation.parent_device_sn WHERE relation.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND relation.effective_to IS NULL AND relation.deleted = b'0' ) SELECT id, parent_device_sn, child_device_sn, position_code, assembly_type, effective_from, effective_to, evidence_ref, source_system, source_key, source_version, version, tenant_id FROM assembly_tree ORDER BY tree_depth, position_code, id
mapper.update: UPDATE ast_device_assembly SET effective_to = #{effectiveAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND child_device_sn = #{childDeviceSn} AND effective_to IS NULL AND deleted = b'0'
